analyst.summary: Avalon Technologies is a full-service electronics contract manufacturer (EMS) that has shown genuine, steady improvement over the last three quarters in both revenue growth (~40% YoY) and operating margin (10% to 12%). The company's three-year-average return on equity, however, is only about 11%, well below the much stronger recent-quarter figure, and the stock trades at a very rich ~104x earnings with no dividend. We rate it a Hold: real and improving momentum, but priced for a much longer track record of high returns than the company has actually delivered so far.
